title: Patatas Bravas with Spicy Tomato Sauce
summary: Crispy roasted potatoes are served with a smoky, spicy tomato sauce inspired by classic Spanish patatas bravas. It’s bold, vegan, and perfect as a simple dinner or shared plate.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into bite-size chunks and pat them dry.
Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, black pepper, and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Spread them out on a baking tray in a single layer.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the potatoes are deep golden and crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add the garlic and chilli, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the remaining smoked paprika and tomato paste, then add the canned tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, and water. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until thick and glossy.
Taste the sauce and adjust with a little more salt if needed. Spoon the spicy tomato sauce over the crispy potatoes and finish with chopped parsley.
